stories.i_want: the system to automatically generate a pre-filled SEC Form 4 after I execute a trade
stories.so_that: I can comply with regulatory deadlines without manual effort
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN a valid securities transaction is recorded WHEN the transaction event is received THEN a pre-filled Form 4 is generated within 5 minutes with all required fields populated
GIVEN a transaction is missing required data WHEN generation is attempted THEN the form is flagged incomplete and the legal team is notified

stories.i_want: the system to validate all form fields before submission
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN all required fields are correctly filled WHEN the form is submitted THEN submission proceeds
GIVEN a required field is missing or invalid WHEN the form is submitted THEN submission is blocked and a specific error message is shown

stories.i_want: to review and edit a pre-filled form before submission
stories.so_that: I can correct any errors before it becomes an official filing
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN a pre-filled form is generated WHEN I edit a field THEN the change is saved and re-validated
GIVEN I enter invalid data WHEN I save THEN a validation error is displayed and the invalid value is not persisted as valid

stories.i_want: to approve a validated form for submission
stories.so_that: only accurate filings are sent toward the regulator
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN a form passes validation WHEN I approve it THEN it is marked ready-for-submission and a (mocked) EDGAR submission connector call is recorded
GIVEN a form has not passed validation WHEN I attempt to approve it THEN approval is blocked

stories.i_want: every generate/edit/approve/submit action logged with timestamp and user
stories.so_that: I have a defensible audit trail
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN a user performs any of generate/edit/approve/submit WHEN the action completes THEN an audit entry is written with actor, action, filing ID, and timestamp

stories.i_want: to view my historical filings and their statuses
stories.so_that: I have visibility for compliance purposes
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN I am authorized WHEN I open filing history THEN I see all my filings with current status and key dates

stories.i_want: a notification when a regulatory form is generated
stories.so_that: I am aware compliance action is needed
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN a form is generated WHEN the event fires THEN the executive sees an in-app notification

stories.i_want: to be alerted if a filing deadline is at risk
stories.so_that: I can take action to avoid penalties
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN a filing is unsubmitted and less than 12 hours remain against the EDGAR 5:30pm ET cutoff WHEN the threshold is crossed THEN a deadline-risk notification is shown to executive and legal

stories.i_want: confirmation when a filing is successfully submitted
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN a form is submitted WHEN submission completes THEN a confirmation notification is shown to executive and legal

stories.i_want: to monitor all filing statuses in a dashboard
stories.so_that: I have real-time visibility into compliance across all executives
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN I access the dashboard WHEN it loads THEN all pending, completed, and error filings are displayed with status and deadline countdowns

stories.i_want: to filter and search filings by executive or status
stories.so_that: I can find what needs my attention quickly
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN filings exist across multiple executives and statuses WHEN I apply a filter THEN only matching filings are shown
